lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What do you want to do in the future?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng kāi yì jiā xiǎo fànguǎn.
lines.en: I want to open a small restaurant.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 因为我喜欢做菜，也喜欢跟人聊天。
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi wǒ xǐhuan zuò cài, yě xǐhuan gēn rén liáotiān.
lines.en: Because I like cooking and chatting with people.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ yào xiān xué zuò cài ba?
lines.en: Then you have to learn to cook first?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 对，我现在每周末都在学。
lines.pinyin: Duì, wǒ xiànzài měi zhōumò dōu zài xué.
lines.en: Yes, now I study every weekend.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Do you need a lot of money?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Xūyào, suǒyǐ wǒ hái zài nǔlì.
lines.en: Yes, so I'm still working hard.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 你一定可以的，我相信你。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yídìng kěyǐ de, wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ.
lines.en: You can definitely do it, I believe in you.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Xièxie, dào shíhou qǐng nǐ chīfàn!
lines.en: Thank you, I'll treat you to a meal then!
